movementActionEventQuickHelpIntro: Action events define exactly when an action sequence runs relative to the train and the selected route resource. Blocking sequences must finish before the Movement can continue past that event.
movementEventHelpApproach: Runs when the train is approaching this resource, before it has arrived or entered it.
movementEventExampleApproach: Play a station announcement or sound the horn before reaching the block.
movementEventHelpArrived: Runs when the Movement considers the train arrived at this block. This belongs to arrival processing, so a blocking delay here postpones completion of arrival rather than the next departure.
movementEventExampleArrived: Turn on lights or play an arrival announcement immediately when the train reaches the station block.
movementEventHelpBeforeDepart: Runs after the train is already at the block and immediately before the next departure. A blocking sequence delays the departure, which makes this the right place for station dwell time.
movementEventExampleBeforeDepart: Wait 10 seconds plus a random 0-5 seconds before departing from a station.
movementEventHelpDepart: Runs at the departure event when the Movement starts leaving the current block.
movementEventExampleDepart: Sound the horn or switch on a locomotive function as departure begins.
movementEventHelpEnter: Runs when the train enters a segment resource according to its sensor condition.
movementEventExampleEnter: Start a bridge sound or set a function when the train enters a track segment.
movementEventHelpLeave: Runs when the train leaves the selected resource according to its leave condition.
movementEventExampleLeave: Turn off a function or stop an effect when the train clears the resource.
movementEventHelpAfterLeave: Runs after the block has been left and the Movement has completed the leave handling for it.
movementEventExampleAfterLeave: Switch off rear lights or run cleanup actions after the train has fully cleared the block.

movementResourceAnySensorOn: Default: ANY assigned sensor is ON.
movementPagesHelp: Play runs the dedicated MovementEngine. Stop All stops every active Movement. Abort All aborts every active Movement and requests E-STOP once. Emergency Stop controls the command-station pause state directly.

Target block locomotive/target ownership checks remain active even when its occupancy sensor is ignored.
